comment: Multi-day registry of toxic hourly zones to trace and compare trading toxicity patterns. Enforcing static lockouts based on a single day's volatility is avoided to prevent unnecessary opportunity costs. This registry will be audited over 3-4 days to establish statistical certainty.

04.name: 04:00 AM ET (08:00 UTC) - Toxic Dead Zone

09.name: 09:00 AM ET (13:00 UTC) - US Open Churn

15.name: 03:00 PM ET (19:00 UTC) - US Close Chaos

00.name: 12:00 AM ET (04:00 UTC) - Session Transition / Streak Reset Overload

05.name: 05:00 AM ET (09:00 UTC) - European Session Open Churn

10.name: 10:00 AM ET (14:00 UTC) - Mid-Morning Volatility Run

19.name: 07:00 PM ET (23:00 UTC) - Evening Reset / Chop Zone

03.name: 03:00 AM ET (07:00 UTC) - Asian Volatility Trap

21.name: 09:00 PM ET (01:00 UTC next day) - Late Night Drift
